name: grokcli
tagline: Drafts tight coding prompts, runs them headless on your machine, ships the commit.
description: A helper that lives on the terminal side of your workflow. You describe the job, it shapes a focused prompt for the task and executes it through a headless Grok CLI running on your own hardware. When the work is done you get a pushed commit plus a short report of what changed, so nothing ships silently.
author: nil0bject
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
